items.item_text: Minimum one (1) year of experience performing healthcare insurance authorization, benefit verification, and/or financial clearance functions in a clinical or medical office setting.

In this role, you will be responsible for obtaining authorization for and scheduling chemotherapy, injections, and procedures within the office, at UCLA facilities, and at outside facilities. Serve as a vital component in the pre-service financial clearance process by verifying benefits and eligibility, determining patient liabilities, documenting benefit and authorization in Electronic Medical Record (EMR), and ensuring our Financial Counselors are informed of financial risks prior to service. Provide a high level of customer service. Major duties include:  verifying insurance benefits for requested procedures and medications, confirming and obtaining appropriate authorization for office visits, procedures, chemotherapy, etc., and special projects as assigned.
Working knowledge of insurance authorization, benefits structure, and verification process for major medical insurance plans.
Ability to determine correct payer/medical group for authorization review and navigate payer-specific processes.

Skill in recognizing an emergency or high priority situation and taking appropriate and immediate action.  Demonstrated ability to maintain composure when confronted by difficult situations and to respond professionally.
Possesses strong customer service skills to promote pleasant and effective interactions with patients, staff, and physicians.
Knowledge of billing and diagnosis codes and medical office procedures.
Ability to set priorities and complete assignments in a timely manner under minimal supervision.
Advanced organizational skills to ensure a workable, efficient workspace and accomplish established objectives.
Skill in adapting to frequently changing insurance requirements, workflows, system updates, policies and procedures.
Knowledge of State and Federal programs to ensure reimbursement from Medicare, Medi-Cal, or other sponsoring agencies.
Skill in analyzing information, problems, situations, practices, and procedures to recognize alternatives and provide solutions.
Ability to work as part of a team, maintaining confidentiality in all assignments, and showing initiative in identifying and solving problems as they occur.
